tools.description: Take a screenshot of the device (iOS simulator or Android emulator). Returns a base64-encoded PNG image.
tools.name: grantiva_screenshot

tools.description: Tap on a UI element by accessibility label or by coordinates. After tapping, returns the updated accessibility tree so you can see what changed.

label.description: Accessibility label of the element to tap

x.description: X coordinate to tap, in the same unit as the hierarchy frames: points on iOS, dp on Android (used if label is not provided)

y.description: Y coordinate to tap, in the same unit as the hierarchy frames: points on iOS, dp on Android (used if label is not provided)

tools.name: grantiva_tap

tools.description: Swipe on the device (iOS simulator or Android emulator) screen. After swiping, returns the updated accessibility tree.

direction.description: Swipe direction: up, down, left, right

tools.name: grantiva_swipe

tools.description: Type text into the currently focused field on the device (iOS simulator or Android emulator). After typing, returns the updated accessibility tree.
tools.name: grantiva_type

tools.description: Get the current accessibility tree (view hierarchy) of the running app. Returns a JSON tree of all UI elements with their labels, types, frames, and states.
tools.name: grantiva_a11y_tree

tools.description: Run accessibility audit on the current screen. Checks for missing labels on interactive elements and tap targets smaller than 44pt (iOS) or 48dp (Android).
tools.name: grantiva_a11y_check

tools.description: Build the project: xcodebuild on iOS, Gradle on Android. Returns build result with success status, duration, warnings, and errors.

emulator.description: AVD name to use, booting it if needed (Android; uses grantiva-android.yml)

module.description: Gradle module to assemble (Android; uses grantiva-android.yml, default app)

scheme.description: Xcode scheme to build (uses grantiva.yml if omitted)

variant.description: Gradle build variant, e.g. debug or freeDebug (Android; default debug)

tools.name: grantiva_build

tools.description: Build, install, and launch the app on the simulator or emulator.

emulator.description: AVD name to use, booting it if needed (Android; uses grantiva-android.yml)

module.description: Gradle module to assemble (Android; uses grantiva-android.yml, default app)

scheme.description: Xcode scheme to build (uses grantiva.yml if omitted)

variant.description: Gradle build variant, e.g. debug or freeDebug (Android; default debug)

tools.name: grantiva_run

tools.description: Run the project's test suite using xcodebuild test (iOS only). Returns pass/fail counts and output.

scheme.description: Xcode scheme to test (uses grantiva.yml if omitted)

tools.name: grantiva_test

tools.description: List available iOS simulators with their name, UDID, state, runtime, and availability.
tools.name: grantiva_sim_list

tools.description: Boot an iOS simulator by name or UDID. Returns the booted device info.

name.description: Simulator name or UDID to boot (default: 'iPhone 16')

tools.name: grantiva_sim_boot

tools.description: Create or idempotently reuse an exact named simulator, optionally booting it to readiness. Only 'name' is required: the device type is inferred from the name and the runtime defaults to the newest installed one.
tools.name: grantiva_sim_ensure

tools.description: Explicitly delete one simulator by its exact name or UDID.
tools.name: grantiva_sim_delete

tools.description: List Android Virtual Devices with the serial of each one that is running.
tools.name: grantiva_emulator_list

tools.description: Boot an Android emulator by AVD name, or use it if it is already running. Defaults to emulator in grantiva-android.yml.
tools.name: grantiva_emulator_boot

tools.description: Create an AVD when missing (installing its system image first) and optionally boot it. Only 'name' is required.
tools.name: grantiva_emulator_ensure

tools.description: Delete an AVD Grantiva created. Pass force to delete one it did not create. A running AVD is never deleted.
tools.name: grantiva_emulator_delete

tools.description: Get current project context: config, booted simulator or running emulator, Xcode or Android SDK, and runner session status.
tools.name: grantiva_context

tools.description: Execute a batch of UI actions sequentially. Each step is an object with one action key. Supported actions: tap (by label), tap_xy (by coordinates), swipe (direction), type (text), wait (seconds). Returns the final accessibility tree after all steps complete.

steps.description: Array of step objects. Each has one key: tap, tap_xy, swipe, type, or wait.

swipe.description: Swipe direction: up, down, left, right

tap_xy.description: Coordinates to tap: {x, y}, in the same unit as the hierarchy frames (points on iOS, dp on Android)

type.description: Text to type into focused field

tools.name: grantiva_script

tools.description: Capture screenshots for all configured screens. Equivalent to 'grantiva diff capture --no-build --json'. Assumes the app is already running on the device.
tools.name: grantiva_vrt_capture

tools.description: Compare current captures against baselines. Equivalent to 'grantiva diff compare --json'. Returns diff results per screen with pixel and perceptual metrics.
tools.name: grantiva_vrt_compare

tools.description: Promote current captures to baselines. Equivalent to 'grantiva diff approve [screens] --json'. Approves all screens if none specified.

screens.description: Screen names to approve. If omitted, approves all.

tools.name: grantiva_vrt_approve
